content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-235. - Vehicles generally.
content.summary:

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to equip a vehicle used in the operation of a
               contract security agency, or while performing the duties of a business or security
               guard, in any manner resembling an authorized emergency vehicle as defined in C.R.S.
               § 42-4-213, as may from time-to-time be amended.
(Code 1981, § 21-95; Ord. No. 3739, § 2, 3-4-2002)
